_doc: Transects of the edge blend test (P2-009, tools/bake/areas/blend.ts): each runs from well inside a drawn area across its edge into the ground beyond. The bake samples the profile mix every 25 m along each (harness/reports/map/areas/generator.json, picture blend_<stage>.png) and checks that the area's own weight only falls and that no step between two samples is over 20 percent. from and to are [lon, lat].
